lines.en: I trot with small quick steps.
Neck up, head held high.

lines.zh: 两只大眼睛一直看四周
lines.en: Both big eyes keep scanning.
I follow the hill line.
The grass is thin; I pick out the tender patches.
I stop suddenly mid-stride.
When the wind stirs the grass, I duck my neck.
I keep to the low ground.
I weave across the savanna.

lines.zh: 脚落得很轻，怕惊动什么
lines.en: My feet land lightly, afraid to startle anything.
I follow a group of my kind.
Any sound turns my head.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴起着平衡作用
lines.en: My tail keeps me balanced.
I run a few steps, then stop to listen.
I walk along the brush edge.
Thin legs, but not slow when running.
I stand motionless, neck stretched.
My eyes cover every direction.
I chew a piece of dry grass.
My kind are here.
I hear claws somewhere far.
I am timid, but I do not run.
I blink slowly.
The sun on my back is pleasant.
I lift one foot and hold it.
A blade of grass touches my nose.
I am looking for higher ground.

lines.zh: 风里有食肉动物的味道
lines.en: There is predator scent in the wind.
I have not decided where to go.
I lift my head; my eyes are large.
I take two steps back and stop.
I am not about to run.
There is no blood on you.
I turn my head and use the other eye.
My neck is thin and easily startled.
I relax a little.
Are you going to come closer?

lines.zh: 我想确认你不会扑过来
lines.en: I want to be sure you will not pounce.
I edge forward half a step.
I cry out and leap away.
I spin half around in panic.
That set my legs shaking.
I retreat a long way.
I duck my neck to shield my head.
I am going to run. Truly.
My body is light and easily hurt.
Blood runs down my leg.
I do not want another.
Those leaves look tender.
I know what is in your hand.
I will take a bite and back off.
This is sweeter than my usual grass.
Is there more? I would eat more.

lines.zh: 我吃东西的时候也在看四周
lines.en: I watch around me even while eating.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我吃得更安心
lines.en: Step back and I eat easier.
I will go when I finish.
Startled, I leap aside.

lines.zh: 我的身体很轻，撞不疼你
lines.en: I am light; I will not hurt you.
You touched my flank.
I back off, neck drawn in.
I spin a clumsy circle.
I kick up dust.
I return to my original spot.
Do not move suddenly.
There are many of us in the herd.
I walk behind her.
Same grass, eating together.
I am timid, but I will guard.
We run in neat formation.
She will call first if something comes.
I need not compete.
Watching all around together is enough.
We do not leave this herd.
Enough grass makes for easy days.
I lower my head and touch it with my nose.
I pick it up, then drop it.
I have not seen this before.
I nudge it aside.
It is too small; I cannot see it well.
I step back so you can take it.
I can carry this weight.
Let me smell it first.
You have appeared on my path.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，又低头看草
lines.en: I look up at you, then down at the grass.
My hind legs are already trembling.
My herd is all watching.

lines.zh: 你如果追，我会跑得很快
lines.en: If you chase, I will run very fast.

lines.zh: 这条路通向我熟悉的坡
lines.en: This path leads to a slope I know.
I bolt first — you won't catch me.
Stand still and I will stay.
I am afraid, but I do not want to show it.
You have no weapon, do you?
That puts me more at ease.
I crouch low, ready to dodge.
I keep watching your hands.
My eyes sit wide and see far.
I can run at any moment.
I know this savanna better than you.
From the slope I can see far.
My heart is beating fast.
I will not call; that would be worse.
My companions are beyond the brush.

lines.zh: 我还在这里，只是离远些
lines.en: I am still here, just farther off.
The slower you walk, the calmer I am.
My legs are ready.
The grass is open; there is room to run.
Come closer and I will bolt.
I kick out with a hind leg.
That came out of panic.
I bump you and run.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的护腿上
lines.en: That hit your leg guard.
I have backed off again.
In a panic I kick out with one leg.
I raise a forefoot and push.
I am not strong.
Dust hides half of me.
I missed my footing.
I come out from behind the slope.
Wind bends the grass on the hills.
First I check my surroundings.

lines.zh: 我站得低，不容易被看见
lines.en: I keep low so I am not seen.
The sun lights the ground brightly.
The grass here is reasonably tender.
I test the ground with a foot.

lines.zh: 空气中有一点危险的味道
lines.en: There is a faint danger in the air.

lines.zh: 我脖子一伸，听见了什么
lines.en: Neck extended, I catch a sound.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向草多的地方
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the thicker grass.
Back on this savanna again.
Wind pushes cloud shadows across the ground.
I keep glancing behind.
The heat of fire is unbearable.
I land with a leg twisted.
I am no swimmer; I kick desperately.
The blast throws me into the grass.
Hungry enough to chew tough grass.
Thunder and lightning freeze me.
